correctness.rationale: Explicit Fourier coefficients give the exact original kernel (including integer shifts). Parseval and parity yield W with eigenvalues a,b and determinant ab. The fiber multiplier m_t(theta)D_t is an exact unitary model. Its conjugate B_t has |det|=1 and trace(B_t*B_t)=2+4 beta^2 sin^2(pi t/2); elementary singular-value algebra gives the all-t closed form. Fiber vectors in the constant top singular eigenspace are actual infinite-dimensional weighted-ell2 extremizers; no finite test substitutes for proof. Equal-weight and integer boundary cases and strong continuity follow rigorously.

value.rationale: The natural minimal nonconstant periodic metric for fractional discrete translations loses isometricity in a precisely quantified way. This exact full-time sharp norm and equality profile determines the maximum amplification and all isometry parameters, plus a nonnormal-versus-unit-spectral-radius separation that the general norm-equivalence bound misses. It is a motivated sharp invariant for weighted discrete transform stability rather than an arbitrary finite table or routine parameter change; no broader theorem or priority beyond the compared literature is claimed.
